versions.subject: Add Inveigh Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: '\Inveigh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - '\Inveigh.exe'
        - '\Inveigh.dll'
    - Description: 'Inveigh'
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -SpooferIP'
        - ' -ReplyToIPs '
        - ' -ReplyToDomains '
        - ' -ReplyToMACs '
        - ' -SnifferIP'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\Inveigh.exe" OR OriginalFileName IN ("\\Inveigh.exe", "\\Inveigh.dll") OR Description="Inveigh" OR CommandLine IN ("* -SpooferIP*", "* -ReplyToIPs *", "* -ReplyToDomains *", "* -ReplyToMACs *", "* -SnifferIP*")
